Effect.LegacyPixelateFrozen.zh: 当前系统使用静态马赛克；下层画面变化时不会自动更新。
Effect.LegacyPixelateFrozen.en: This system uses a frozen pixelated region; changes underneath are not updated automatically.

Effect.LegacyLiveRegion.zh: 实时桌面马赛克需要 Windows 10 2004 或更新版本；当前区域显示占位遮盖，可重新绘制为静态马赛克。
Effect.LegacyLiveRegion.en: Live desktop pixelation requires Windows 10 2004 or later. Existing regions show a placeholder cover; redraw them to create frozen pixelated regions.
